dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-back toward the visible posterior peduncle point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform light-grey median intensity, significantly lighter than slate-grey but darker than mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey mottling distributed sparsely across the dorsal surface, primarily along the central axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between slightly darker pigmented regions and the primary light-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear, light-colored vertical markings (rake marks) visible across the dorsal mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings/scratches on the dorsal plane, likely healed rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular blowhole visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
